Our Story

Founded on a Vision to Transform Education in Bihar

RK Ranjan Classes was established in 2023 by Ravi Kr. Ranjan — with one bold mission: to prove that students in Bihar are capable of understanding deeply, thinking critically, and succeeding brilliantly — when they are taught the right way.

This institute was not built to be another coaching centre. It was built to be a movement against rote learning — a place where every student is treated as a thinker, not a memorizer. Where concept clarity is the foundation, and real understanding is the goal.

NEP 2020 Aligned — India's new education policy implemented in full
Concept-First Teaching — no syllabus completion pressure, only real learning
Max 20 Students per Batch — personal attention guaranteed for every child
Structured Assessment — Written Test + Oral + Project + Participation = 50 Marks
Zero Exam Fear Culture — continuous evaluation removes pressure and stress
Recognised by Media — Dainik Jagran & Dainik Bhaskar both covered our results
Our Purpose

Why We Exist — Our Core Vision

Every decision at RK Ranjan Classes is driven by one question: "Will this actually help the student think better?"

🧠
Move from Rote to Real Learning
India's old education system trained students to memorize and reproduce. We train students to understand, question, and apply. Ratta system ends here.
💬
Build Communication & Expression
Knowing an answer is not enough — expressing it confidently is equally important. Our Oral/Viva sessions build articulation and communication skills.
🔗
Connect Learning to Real Life
Through projects, case studies, and real-world examples, we ensure students understand why they are learning what they are learning.
📊
Reduce Exam Fear & Stress
Continuous, structured evaluation means no sudden pressure. Students are assessed every 2 weeks, so nothing is ever a shock. Confidence builds naturally.
🌱
Overall Development, Not Just Marks
Critical thinking, problem-solving, discipline, creativity — these are not extras. At RK Ranjan Classes, they are central to the education we provide.
🚀
Future-Ready Students for Bihar
We want every student who walks out of this institute to be confident, capable, and ready — not just for the next exam, but for life.

India's New Education Policy

How We Follow NEP 2020

India's National Education Policy 2020 transformed the framework of learning. RK Ranjan Classes was built from day one to fully align with this vision.

📋
Continuous & Comprehensive Evaluation

Assessment is conducted every 2 weeks — on the 2nd and 4th Saturday of every month — covering all dimensions of learning, not just written tests.

✍️
Written Test — 30 Marks (MCQ + Subjective)

10 MCQs (concept-based) + 20-mark subjective section with short answer and reasoning questions — testing real understanding, not memory.

🎤
Oral / Viva — 5 Marks

1–2 concept-based questions per student, 1–2 minute verbal explanation. Builds articulation, confidence, and clarity of thought.

🏗️
Project / Activity — 10 Marks

Real-world projects: diagrams, models, surveys, case studies, reports. Submission + 2–3 minute explanation builds creativity and application skills.

🙋
Class Participation + Homework — 5 Marks

Regularity, timely homework, active participation, and discipline — because character and consistency matter as much as marks.

Total: 50 Marks Every 2 Weeks 2nd & 4th Saturday NEP 2020 Aligned

Our Journey

From Vision to Bihar's Best

How RK Ranjan Classes grew from a bold idea into an award-winning institution — in just 2 years.

2022–2023
The Vision is Born
Ravi Kr. Ranjan, with 10+ years of teaching experience, identifies a critical gap — Bihar's students are smart, but the system teaches them to memorize, not understand. The idea for RK Ranjan Classes takes shape.
2023
RK Ranjan Classes Founded
Officially established at KG Road, Arrah — Reg. No. BR-08-0004021. From day one, the institute adopts the NEP 2020 model with structured 50-mark continuous assessment and concept-first teaching.
2023–2024
Rapid Trust Building
Word spreads across Arrah. Parents and students experience a fundamentally different kind of teaching. Google reviews begin pouring in. Rating reaches 4.9 stars. Student count grows to 1500+.
2024
3700+ Students Milestone
Crossed 3700 students. 105+ verified Google reviews. Instagram and Facebook community grows significantly. Students begin reporting dramatic improvement in both understanding and exam performance.
2025
100% Result + Best Institute Award
The proof arrives — 100% board pass rate in 2025. Student Ankush Raj becomes District Topper with 95%. Dainik Jagran and Dainik Bhaskar both cover the results. Best Institute Award 2025 received at Annual Prize Distribution.
